files.reason: collectFilePaths receives only an allocator, borrowed file/directory cache metadata and an independent Paths pool. It allocates output paths and pool storage, but cannot access or grow dwarf.compile_unit_list. numericRow receives a version, a by-value LineEntry and a file count. installed enumerates every fixed binary_names entry and assigns the corresponding artifact slot before returning; any failure returns an error rather than a partial array. ZBC does not prove complete indexed loop initialization.

parseMapping is pure and allocator-free. It receives a borrowed location string and two borrowed context strings, not argv or an alias to its backing storage, so it cannot grow or invalidate the iterated argument slice.

Exact native next-line controls preserve strict malformed-registry tests and canonical path/hash checks.

The analyzer does not derive that lower bound from the loop.
